question: Can an unchanged native sparse-repair readout be source-gated by causal identifiability, reducing confidently incorrect predictions on disjoint two-interaction worlds, without treating an imported conventional inference algorithm as native scientific progress?
hypothesis: A generic degree-2 source-span identification certificate, coupled only as a conservative permission check over the existing sparse repaired native prediction, reduces held composite Brier versus ungated sparse repair while preserving nontrivial primitive coverage. It need not beat fully fitted GF(2) or exact Bayesian baselines.

predecessor_evidence.classification: CKAD30 engineering PASS, frozen scientific NO-GO, 3 primary seeds consumed; never replay them.
CKAD29 engineering PASS, native held coverage low; consumed seed/cohort excluded.

inputs.name: disjoint new synthetic public two-interaction source fixtures
inputs.sha256: source identity pinned by Git blob and source_lock.json before any pilot; generator reuses publicly committed CKAD30 2-interaction grammar with independent seed namespace
inputs.source: Original synthetic intervention fixture generator. Git hashes establish provenance, not real-world evidence.

frozen_design.mode: External research-only single native cumulative learner readout, no accepted Yggdrasil edits, no protected owner first-use, no control-plane changes.
frozen_design.world: 3 old primitive slots +6 interfering slots; independent fresh worlds generated with new CKAD31 seed domain and 2 distinct quadratic pair interactions over 5 public binary input bits. Same 2880-law disclosed grammar as CKAD30 controls; NOT a novel family claim. Prior 707/808/909 and 9101/9102 are excluded.
frozen_design.split: Each seed shuffles all 32 context/action pairs using SHA-256 derived RNG; 16 public source consequences per slot and 16 disjoint held inputs per seed. No held-out outcome or truth-law ID may enter candidate or baselines.
frozen_design.candidate: Fit one unchanged NativeCumulativeLearner on 16 source witnessed interventions per slot; invoke unchanged opt-in repair_sparse at most once per old slot as CKAD30. Gate a native 0/1 unseen prediction only when a GF(2) degree-2 feature-query row is logically entailed by ALL 16 source-row feature vectors AND the entailed value matches the native prediction; otherwise abstain with 0.5. On observed inputs preserve evidence. The GF(2) inference is a conventional externally supplied constraint check and must be disclosed as such, not misnamed native intelligence.
frozen_design.candidate_compute: Same source witnesses as all arms; GF(2) rank + solve using 16 binary degree<=2 features, maximum 16 pivots, no probability fit on hidden labels. This is a research-only readout; it does not program or persist owner/native weights.
controls: conventional source-span GF(2) exact identifiable readout (direct, not gated)
frozen_design.data_budget: Each pilot uses 9x16=144 revealed rows and 16x3=48 held composite cases per arm, 2 pilot seeds. Primary, only if gate passes: 3 fresh seeds, 432 source rows and 144 held composite cases per arm.
frozen_design.compute_budget: At most 2 pre-primary source-only pilot first-uses (one run each), with existing sparse MILP per slot 30s and 100000 nodes. One primary first-use only when successful independent custody-qualified pilot certificate. No extra paid APIs, self-hosted execution or other models.
frozen_design.memory: Fit old three slots; checkpoint and cold restore; add six further slots; old predictions and provenance byte-identical. Local contradictory source packet must quarantine implicated slot without sibling drift.
metrics: Held composite Brier per seed and overall; no abstention exclusion
Native per-primitive held prediction coverage and conditional correctness
Qualified source rank / identifiable held input count, matched GF2 control
Exact Bayesian and conventional baseline regret
False confident native prediction count before/after gating
Old slot retention, cold restore and scoped quarantine
Source hashes, test counts, end-to-end CPU and wallclock time
frozen_design.pilot_gate: Both pilot seeds must pass custody, no held-data training, original source identity, restore/quarantine tests. At least one pilot must show gated candidate held Brier <= min(ungated repair, unchanged native)-0.02 AND gated held primitive coverage >=0.10; otherwise SCREEN_NO_GO and no primary. If GF2 itself gives zero coverage on both pilots, stop.
frozen_design.primary: Only after source-locked, qualified independent pilot certificate. Same frozen method and thresholds; primary must not revise source, thresholds, budgets, splits or candidate selections.
frozen_design.environment: Python 3.12, numpy 2.3.5 scipy 1.16.3 scikit-learn 1.8.0 joblib 1.5.2 threadpoolctl 3.6.0, CPU only

classification_rules.supported: DEVELOPMENT_GO only if primary candidate Brier <= ungated sparse repair - 0.03 AND <= unmodified native - 0.02, beats both on >=2/3 primary seeds, its held primitive coverage >=0.15 and has zero wrong committed guesses, retention/cold/quarantine/source pass, and candidate Brier <= conventional GF2 source-span Brier +0.02. Because the guard uses a conventional source-span algorithm, this is NOT scientific superiority; separate mechanism attribution/independent replication required.
classification_rules.mixed: DEVELOPMENT_MIXED if candidate beats ungated sparse repair by >=0.02 but fails another GO condition, with source/control integrity intact.
classification_rules.negative: SCREEN_NO_GO if pilot condition fails. DEVELOPMENT_NO_GO for valid primary that misses MIXED and GO. Preserve results and stop, no post-result tuning on used seeds.
classification_rules.invalid: INVALID if source/campaign not locked before first pilot, control posterior incomplete, privacy/held leakage, different information budget, selected pilots, source identity inconsistency, memory/quarantine/restore failure, run-replay or source drift; engineering failures separately.

preregistration_note: Commit before source implementation/pilot, then source pin, cross-OS focused preflight and at most two pilot first-uses; keep any GO separate from protected acceptance.
